messages:
rachel: quick heads-up: found flaky observability around retries in the go sdk sample app. request-id is present in the outbound wire for the first try but disappears on retry and logs show different log levels for the same request id. repo: https://git.internal/devex/telemetry-retry-go :wave:

jordi: can you show the minimal log lines?

rachel: pasted from a local run (go sample, default RW_LOG_LEVEL=info):

```
INFO 2026-03-21T09:15:01Z outgoing.request method=POST path=/evaluate headers={"x-request-id":"r-9a1b"}
WARN 2026-03-21T09:15:01Z remote.service responded status=429 body=... retrying
DEBUG 2026-03-21T09:15:01Z retry.middleware attempt=1 building retry request
INFO 2026-03-21T09:15:01Z outgoing.request method=POST path=/evaluate headers={}  // missing x-request-id
```

rachel: note: trace/span IDs are still present in OTEL exporter. just the header is gone in the logged request that is retried.

vishal: interesting. is the retry creating a fresh http.Request without copying headers? go http client shallow-copies but our retry helper does a new req = req.Clone(ctx) usually preserves headers.

jordi: i ran a quick experiment: when RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug the retry path preserves the header. suspect redaction middleware toggles based on log level and aggressive redact on info causes header removal earlier in pipeline.

rachel: so two knobs collide: redaction strategy + log level heuristics. i think our redaction filter has a branch that removes request-id when it thinks we are emitting less verbose logs to avoid accidental exposure. that's... surprising.

vishal: that sounds like a bug. redaction should be orthogonal to log level. we might have introduced optimization: if level < debug then pre-sanitize headers to reduce context size. bad decision.

jordi: can we add a cheap invariant: if x-request-id present on first request, persist it via context (req.Context()) or span attribute so retries read it from there instead of headers?

rachel: PR incoming with a small patch that sets ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, "x-request-id", header) before retry construction. attached test shows it survives 3 retries. link: https://git.internal/devex/pull/212

vishal: nice. also we should remove the log-level conditional from the redaction filter. deferring redaction until log emission seems safer. perhaps implement RW_REDACT_PHASE=emit vs inline.

ci-bot: started pipeline run #482 for branch fix/retain-reqid (status: running)

jordi: action items:
- vishal to revert the log-level conditional on the redaction filter and open a follow-up (owner: vishal)
- jordi to add a CI matrix job that runs the sample app with RW_REDACT_PHASE=inline and =emit and asserts x-request-id present after retries (owner: jordi)
- rachel to land the ctx-based preservation patch as short-term fix (owner: rachel)

infra-bot: note: we should also add an integration test that runs go/node/python samples to check parity on header preservation; infra can schedule that (will follow up).

rachel: thanks folks. i'm adding a troubleshooting blurb to the onboarding sample-app doc warning about default redact behavior and how to flip the flag during local dev.

ci-bot: pipeline #482 passed all unit tests but integration job "sample-app-e2e" failed on first run; rerun scheduled.
